description: CsNa₃PbO₄ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Cs sites. In the first Cs site, Cs is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Cs-O bond distances ranging from 3.15-3.47 Å. In the second Cs site, Cs is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Cs-O bond distances ranging from 3.14-3.42 Å. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four PbO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.42 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaO₄ tetrahedra, corners with four PbO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.48 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two PbO₄ tetrahedra, corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one PbO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.50 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two PbO₄ tetrahedra, corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one PbO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.51 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent PbO₄ tetrahedra, corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one PbO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.47 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent PbO₄ tetrahedra, corners with six NaO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one PbO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.55 Å. There are two inequivalent Pb sites. In the first Pb site, Pb is bonded to four O atoms to form PbO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eight NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Pb-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.13 Å. In the second Pb site, Pb is bonded to four O atoms to form PbO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eight NaO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Pb-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.14 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two Cs, three Na, and one Pb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Cs, three Na, and one Pb atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Cs, three Na, and one Pb atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Cs, three Na, and one Pb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two Cs, three Na, and one Pb atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Cs, three Na, and one Pb atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two Cs, three Na, and one Pb atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Cs, three Na, and one Pb atom.
